title: Optimized protocol for gene editing in adipocytes using CRISPR-Cas9 technology
protocol: Dissolve the sgRNA oligonucleotides in ddH2O.
Dilute the dissolved oligonucleotides to a final concentration of 10 μM.
Set up the annealing reaction for each pair of sgRNA oligonucleotides.
Anneal these sgRNA oligonucleotides at 95°C for 5 min.
Cool the mixture to room temperature (∼25°C).
Digest the lentiCRISPRv2 plasmid (1 μg) with 0.5 μL BsmBI enzyme at 55°C for 1 h.
Run samples on a 1% (wt/vol) agarose gel to verify the appropriately sized fragment (12,994-nt DNA fragment).
Successful digestion should yield 12,994-nt and 1,879-nt DNA fragments.
Set up the ligation reaction for each sgRNA.
Incubate the ligation reaction at room temperature (∼25°C) for 2 hours.
Transform the ligation reaction into a Trans5α chemically competent cell.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 minutes.
Heat shock the mixture at 42°C for 30 seconds.
Re-incubate the mixture on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 100 μL LB buffer to the ligation mixture from step 3c.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 1 hour in a shaker.
Add the mixture onto an LB plate with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the LB plate at 37°C for 12–16 hours.
Prepare a negative control plate (ligation of BsmBI-digested lentiCRISPRv2 alone without annealed sgRNA oligo insert).
Assess the plate for colony growth.
Select two or three colonies from the lentiCRISPR-sgRNA plate to confirm the insertion of sgRNA into lentiCRISPRv2 vector.
Grow each single colony in 3 mL LB buffer with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Shake the LB buffer at 37°C for 6 hours.
Isolate plasmid DNA from bacterial cultures using a TIANprep Mini Plasmid Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Verify CRISPR vector, designated as lentiCRISPR-sgRNA1, by sequencing.
Sequence each colony from the U6 promoter using the U6 primer.
Insert the 20-bp sgRNA sequence between the U6 promoter and the remainder of the sgRNA scaffold.
Culture HEK293T cells in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Plate HEK293T cells onto 10-cm plates in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS 16–24 hours prior to transfection.
Typically, plate ∼4 × 10^6 cells in a 10-cm plate (∼5 × 10^4 cells/cm²).
Transfect the plasmid mix when cells are 80%–90% confluent.
Replace the growth medium with 6–8 mL DMEM 4–6 hours before transfection.
Mix the lentiviral plasmid with the packaging vectors (total ∼25 μg plasmid DNA).
Dilute the DNA mixture in 300 μL DMEM by pipetting up and down for a few times.
Gently mix the PEI stock before use.
Add 75 μL PEI to 300 μL DMEM, mixing gently by pipetting up and down for a few times.
Combine the PEI/DMEM solution with the diluted DNA/DMEM mixture and mix immediately by pipetting up and down for a few times or vortexing.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature (∼25°C) for 15 minutes.
Add the mixture to each plate with gentle rocking for 2 or 3 times.
Replace DMEM with growth medium after 4–6 hours.
Collect virus-containing medium 48 hours and 72 hours post-transfection on days 4 and 5.
Filter the collected medium using a 0.45 μm vacuum filter.
Store filtered medium at 4°C for immediate use.
Concentrate the virus-containing medium by centrifugation with a Beckman JA25.50 rotor (capacity for eight tubes) at 48,384 × g for 2 hours at 4°C for long-term storage at -80°C.
Dissolve concentrated lentivirus in cold PBS or DMEM using 200 μL per 50 mL tube as recommended.
Titer the concentrated lentivirus with a commercial qPCR Lentivirus Titration Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Transduce NIH3T3 cells with the titered lentivirus.
Plate NIH3T3 cells in a 12-well plate 1 day before transduction.
Infect cells with lentiviruses at an MOI of ∼30.
Allow lentivirus-infected cells to grow for another 2 days.
Treat cells with 3.5 μg/μL puromycin for 2 days to remove non-infected cells.
Collect cells for genomic DNA extraction.
Set up control groups using lentiviruses that carry no sgRNA or express only GFP.
Extract genomic DNA from different group cells using the TIANamp Genomic DNA Kit, according to manufacturers’ instructions.
Design PCR primers for amplification of the target region with a predicted SpCas9 cut site in the center, producing a ∼600 bp band.
Perform PCR using the specified cycling conditions.
Run the PCR products on a 1% (wt/vol) agarose gel.
Purify the PCR product using a Gel Extraction Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Anneal the purified PCR products by heating to 95°C for 5 min.
Take equal amounts of DNA product from different lentiviruses-treated cells for analysis.
Digest the annealed DNA fragments with 0.5 μL T7 Endonuclease I enzyme at 37°C for 1 hour.
Run samples on a 1% (wt/vol) agarose gel.
Determine the cleavage efficiency by quantifying gel bands without overexposing them.
Prepare the reaction mixture to digest 1 μg of pUC57-MU6-gRNA plasmid DNA.
Digest the pUC57-MU6-gRNA plasmid with BbsI enzyme at 37°C for 2.5 h and run on a 1% agarose gel.
Clone another sgRNA into the pUC57-sgRNA2 vector using identical protocol steps.
Digest the pUC57-sgRNA2 vector with EcoRI enzyme at 37°C for 1 h and run on a 1% agarose gel to verify successful fragment (430-bp-long product).
Digest the lentiCRISPR-sgRNA1 vector with EcoRI enzyme at 37°C for 1 h.
Ligate the Mouse U6-sgRNA2 fragment into the digested lentiCRISPR-sgRNA1.
Infect pre-adipocytes with the inducible CRISPR/Cas9 system to introduce the Cas9 and sgRNA cassettes to cells.
Maintain brown pre-adipocytes and white pre-adipocytes in DMEM supplemented with 20% FBS at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Passage the cells at 1:6 or more every 2 days.
Pre-coat plates with 0.1% gelatin to prevent cell detachment.
Add 1 mL of 0.1% gelatin per well in a 12-well plate, 1.5 mL per well in a 6-well plate, and 6 mL per dish for a 10-cm culture dish.
Plate pre-adipocytes in 6-well plates for lentiviral infection.
Add lentiviruses carrying sgRNA to cells after approximately 8 hours.
Mix ∼6 × 10^5 viral particles with 2 × 10^5 cells.
Treat cells with puromycin at a concentration of 1.5 μg/μL for 2 days after 48 hours of transduction.
Remove non-infected cells following puromycin treatment.
Collect infected cells and plate them in a new 12-well plate for differentiation.
Set up control groups using lentiviruses that carry no sgRNA or express GFP.
Prepare all reagents for adipocyte differentiation before use.
Aliquot stock solutions into small volumes.
Avoid repeatedly freezing and thawing.
Remove growth medium when brown pre-adipocytes grow confluent (day 0).
Add induction medium to induce adipogenesis.
Remove induction medium on day 3.
Add maintenance medium on day 3.
Change maintenance medium every 2 days starting from day 3.
Typically more than 90% of cells are differentiated by day 6 or 7.
Change the maintenance medium daily if it appears yellow.
Collect well-differentiated adipocytes in a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 60 μL RIPA buffer into the tube for one well of a 12-well plate.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down several times.
Place the mixture on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge the sample at 15,294 × g for 15 min.
Transfer the lysis buffer (middle layer) to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 3× SDS-PAGE loading buffer to each tube.
Incubate the mixture at 95°C for 5 min.
